hook_text: 91 ends in 1, it is odd and it looks lonely. Is it prime?
clip_script: Grab some bottle tops. 12 makes rectangles: 2 rows of 6, 3 rows of 4. That is composite. 13? Only one long row. That is prime: exactly two factors, 1 and itself. Now the hundred square. Cross out 1. Keep 2, cross out its multiples. Keep 3, cross out. Keep 5. Keep 7. Stop! What is left is all 25 primes to 100. And 91? Crossed out by 7. 7 times 13. Sneaky! 1 is not prime, and 2 is the only even prime. If it only makes one long row, it is prime.
visual_style: Bottle tops sliding into rectangles, then a hundred square with whole columns and diagonals of multiples crossing out in colour until 25 primes glow.
pacing: Quick rectangle build, a sweeping sieve, and a freeze-frame on 91.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and decide whether 57 is prime.
